collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — GOOD, BAD AND ORDINARY DAYS (DAY-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Wonderful days, rotten days, mixed days and days when nothing much happens at all. Moods come without reasons, small things matter more than they should, and nobody has to end the day happier, wiser or more productive than they started it.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: For once a villager has the hut all to themselves: do absolutely nothing, or do all the things you never get to.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: For the first time in ages, everyone who shares (name1)'s hut is out for the whole day. (name1) has the hut to (him/her)self. No voices, no comings and goings, nobody asking where anything is. (He/she) is standing in the middle of the floor, slightly stunned by the silence, deciding what to do with it.

choices.label: Do All the Things You Never Get To

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) lies down on (his/her) mat in the middle of the day, in the quiet, with the door open and the breeze coming in. (He/she) doesn't sleep. (He/she) doesn't think about anything much. (He/she) just lies there, listening to nothing at all. When everyone comes home at dusk, (he/she) is genuinely pleased to see them.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) sings loudly while sweeping. (He/she) rearranges the baskets without anyone asking why. (He/she) eats lunch sitting in the doorway with (his/her) feet up. It's a lovely day. When everyone comes home, they notice the baskets have moved. Nobody can work out what's different about (name1), but (he/she) seems very relaxed.
